answers.prompt: How do the vLLM judge and training share the 16 GB card?

selected.label: Never concurrent, compose profiles take turns (recommended)

answers.prompt: How are the data contracts set up?

selected.label: Five pandera boundaries + split invariant suite (recommended)

answers.prompt: In the Stage-2 judge, who must agree, and what is the decisive third pass?

selected.label: A. Stage-2 judges agree; Stage 1 breaks ties (recommended)

answers.prompt: If a challenger beats XLM-R base in the week-3 CV, what happens?

selected.label: Switch only if it wins on CV QWK with a paired CI excluding zero and is within the 300M cap; record as a deviation (recommended)

answers.prompt: Can prior violations escalate a V1 verdict into a timeout?

selected.label: No, the engine acts only on V2 and V3 (recommended, matches the proposal's output set)

answers.prompt: When the cited rule has both a discretion flag and a sanction hint, which wins?

selected.label: Discretion flag, route to human review (recommended)
